basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate I (Videographer) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Research & Development Office of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar has invited applications for one temporary position of Project Associate I (Videographer) in the Department of EE, under the project "Silicon and Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing Research and Training Hub (SAMARTH)". The consolidated monthly remuneration is INR 45,000 – 80,000 including HRA, depending on qualification and experience. The appointment is for one year initially, extendable on satisfactory performance up to the project completion date. Applications are made through the link http://recruitment.i

qualification.details: Videography & Camera Operation: hands-on experience operating DSLR, mirrorless or cinema cameras, stabilizers/gimbals and multi-camera setups for studio shoots, lab demonstrations and live events. Video Editing & Post-Production: practical proficiency in industry-standard video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro. Motion Graphics & Visual Aids: experience creating 2D motion graphics, lower thirds, callouts and clean animations using Adobe After Effects (or equivalent) to simplify technical and educational content. Lighting & Audio Setup: practical knowledge of studio/on-location lighting techniques, wireless/boom microphone setups, noise reduction and audio mixing. Color Grading & Multi-Platform Delivery: experience in color correction, maintaining visual consistency, and exporting optimized formats for YouTube, social media and Learning Management Systems. | The notice does not name the discipline that counts as "appropriate". The official notification should be checked for discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate I (Videographer) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Silicon and Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing Research and Training Hub (SAMARTH)
One year initially, extendable on satisfactory performance up to the project completion date
INR 45,000 – 80,000 per month including HRA, depending on qualification and experience

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is either of the following routes, as printed in the notice: B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./M.C.A./LLM./CA/CMA/CS/MBA/Professional qualification or equivalent in an appropriate discipline. OR B.C.A./B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./B.B.A./LLB. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 04 years of post-qualification experience. In both cases the notice requires a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in Class 10 and Class 12. Videography & Camera Operation: hands-on experience operating DSLR, mirrorless or cinema cameras, stabilizers/gimbals and multi-camera setups for studio shoots, lab demonstrations and live events. Video Editing & Post-Production: practical proficiency in industry-standard video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro. Motion Graphics & Visual Aids: experience creating 2D motion graphics, lower thirds, callouts and clean animations using Adobe After Effects (or equivalent) to simplify technical and educational content. Lighting & Audio Setup: practical knowledge of studio/on-location lighting techniques, wireless/boom microphone setups, noise reduction and audio mixing. Color Grading & Multi-Platform Delivery: experience in color correction, maintaining visual consistency, and exporting optimized formats for YouTube, social media and Learning Management Systems. The notice does not name the discipline that counts as "appropriate". The official notification should be checked for discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration including HRA is INR 45,000 – 80,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. House Rent Allowance per month (if applicable) is printed as NIL. The position is temporary: one year initially, extendable on satisfactory performance up to the project completion date.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate I (Videographer) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Project Associate I will be responsible for end-to-end video production, cinematography, post-production editing, motion graphics integration and digital media delivery for the SAMARTH program's educational and outreach initiatives. Key responsibilities: Video Shooting & Production: plan, set up and shoot high-quality video footage for technical courses, semiconductor lab demonstrations, delegates interviews and training workshops. Post-Production & Editing: edit raw footage into cohesive, engaging educational modules, documentary shorts and social media reels with strong narrative pacing. Motion Graphics Integration: design and incorporate custom graphics, text overlays and visual callouts to illustrate technical and scientific concepts. Lighting, Audio & Color Finishing: manage on-site lighting and audio capture, and execute post-production sound balancing and color grading to ensure broadcast-ready quality. Event & Outreach Coverage: film and deliver quick-turnaround highlight videos and visual documentation for workshops, bootcamps and institutional visits. Media Asset Management: maintain an organized archive of raw footage, project files, templates and final deliverables for team access.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate I (Videographer)
content_sections.text: The notice gives no further application steps and lists no documents. For enquiries it names Nihar Ranjan Mohapatra, Professor, EE, [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice does not describe the selection stages. It states that merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment, and that a higher cutoff level may be used. It also says the Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill the position through this round of selection, without assigning any reason.
